_comment: Character cards (Zone A). defense is a fraction (0.10 = 10%). recharge = Energy restored by the Recharge action.

characters.name: Solara
characters.title: Herald of the Dawn

passive.name: Daybreak
passive.text: Your first Attack each wave deals 20 damage instead of 15.

characters.stemFact: The sunlight that reaches Earth's surface in about an hour and a half carries more energy than the whole world uses in a year.

characters.name: Aquor
characters.title: Keeper of the Tides
characters.stemFact: Hydropower turns the energy of falling water into electricity, and it is still the world's single largest source of renewable electricity.

characters.name: Magmaros
characters.title: Heart of the Mantle

passive.name: Core Heat
passive.text: When hit by an enemy special move, reflect 5 damage back.

characters.stemFact: Iceland heats about 9 out of 10 homes with geothermal energy, using hot water from deep underground.

characters.name: Zephyra
characters.title: Rider of the Gale

passive.name: Swift Step
passive.text: On each enemy attack, roll a d6: on 5-6 you dodge it completely.

characters.stemFact: A wind turbine's power grows with the cube of the wind speed: double the wind and you get about 8 times the power.

characters.name: Verdan
characters.title: Warden of the Grove

passive.name: Regrowth
passive.text: While below 50 HP, heal 5 HP at the start of each of your turns.

characters.stemFact: Photosynthesis turns sunlight, water and carbon dioxide into sugar and oxygen. Most crops store only about 1-2% of the sunlight that hits them.
